item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I could go either way on that, depending on what you assume happens to someone when they are transformed.

You could argue that a transformed human is not really a cat, so no, it doesn't work. If you assume that a transformed person retains their intelligence as a cat, I'd go this way.

Or you could say it does work, but while you're transformed into a cat you really ARE a cat, with cat intelligence, so that's OK. When you change back, you're not a cat anymore so you lose the power.

What I'm getting at is I didn't intend it to have the effect of creating a human reality-bender who looks like a cat.
